## Abstract

This report reviews “Does Tax-Benefit Linkage Matter for the Incidence of Payroll Taxes?” It examines the argument that workers’ perceived benefits from a tax influence its pass-through to earnings. My comments focus on potential asymmetry between tax cuts and increases, heterogeneity in perceived tax–benefit linkage, and the role of industry-specific shocks in the empirical designs.
